issue.title: Notify the inbox (Telegram/mobile) when a bead first becomes stranded

task_type_fields.why_out_of_scope: The sase-1no epic plan (plan:202610/stranded_epic_work.md, "Non-goals and follow-ups") explicitly kept Telegram, mobile, and inbox notifications for stranded beads out of scope, and left them for the land agent to triage. That epic delivered only the classifier and the ACE and doctor surfaces. Notification delivery is a separate host-side scheduling and dedupe design.

issue.creation_reason: The sase-1no plan deferred stranded-bead notifications to land-agent triage; ACE flags and doctor only reach a human who is already looking, which is how the 68-hour sase-1n6 stall went unnoticed.
